author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices keys that skip, counting long notes, hearing a question and its answer, and rowing together, with a traditional spiritual.

classes.title: Pull the oars together
classes.goal: Hear the song, row to its beat, then rest five fingers on five keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling pulls that come evenly, one after another

classes.parentPrompt: Sit facing your child, hold hands, and row back and forth to the beat.
classes.childAction: Row with your arms, then rest five fingers on five keys.
classes.bridge: Each pull of the oars is one beat; the boat glides between pulls.

intro.caption: Let's row the boat together
intro.parentCue: hold hands and row back and forth.

games.caption: Thumb on C, five keys
games.parentCue: Thumb on C, left of the two black keys

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the beat and finding the hand's home.

classes.title: Stepping stones: C, E, G
classes.goal: Learn the first line, where C, E and G each skip one key.

mathTarget.parentLine: C, E and G each skip over one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Point to C, E and G; show how each one skips over a key.
classes.childAction: Play C, E, G, hopping over one key each time.
classes.bridge: C, E, G are stepping stones across the river, one key apart.

intro.caption: Hop the stepping stones
intro.parentCue: point to C, E and G before you start.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing keys that skip over one.

classes.title: Hallelujah, hold for four
classes.goal: Learn the Hallelujah and hold its long note for four beats.

mathTarget.parentLine: A long note lasts four beats; we count them together

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' aloud while the long note sings.
classes.childAction: Hold the long note while you count to four together.
classes.bridge: A long note is the boat gliding: hold it while we count to four.

intro.caption: Let the boat glide
intro.parentCue: count one to four on the long note.

games.caption: Glide for four
games.parentCue: Count one to four on the long G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats on a long note.

classes.title: Float up, row home
classes.goal: Learn the last lines and hear one Hallelujah float, the other land home.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first Hallelujah floats up; the second one lands home

classes.parentPrompt: Lift your hands on the first Hallelujah; land them in your lap on the second.
classes.childAction: Hear which Hallelujah floats and which one lands home.
classes.bridge: The first Hallelujah stays on the water; the second rows ashore to C.

intro.caption: Which one lands home?
intro.parentCue: lift your hands, then land them in your lap.

games.caption: Row ashore: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Land your hands in your lap on C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing an ending that sounds finished.

classes.title: Row all the way across
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, all four lines in order.

mathTarget.parentLine: Four lines in order: row, Hallelujah, row, Hallelujah

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the first word of each line if your child gets stuck; don't fix notes.
classes.childAction: Play the four lines in order, from shore to shore.
classes.bridge: Row, Hallelujah, row again, Hallelujah: four pulls to reach the shore.

intro.caption: Row across the whole river
intro.parentCue: sing the next word if your child gets stuck.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing four lines in order.

classes.title: The big oar pull
classes.goal: Practise the long-short spot slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long note and one quick note, like a big oar pull

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly, saying 'looong-short', then try it a little faster.
classes.childAction: Play G long and E quick, slowly first, then faster.
classes.bridge: Long-short is a big oar pull, then a quick splash.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a long note and a quick note.

classes.title: Steady oars, slow boat
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one to four keeps every note evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' softly while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while you count to four with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Slow, even oars keep the boat straight across the river.

intro.caption: Slow and steady oars
intro.parentCue: count one to four softly as you go.

games.caption: Row and count to four
games.parentCue: Count one to four out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing evenly, counting to four.

classes.title: Row with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep rowing!
classes.bridge: The music is the river; keep rowing and it carries you along.

intro.caption: Row along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Row ashore for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, singing the Hallelujahs together.

mathTarget.parentLine: One part calls, another answers; together they make the song

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; sing the Hallelujahs together while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the whole song for teddy, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Push off from the shore, row across, and land home on C.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, call and answer.
